integrity: The claim is supported by a complete symbolic proof, three explicit finite signature matrices, and a standard-library exhaustive checker. All computational inputs needed for the claim are embedded.
scientific_limitations: The all-alphabet result is a constructive upper bound with a general lower bound, not an exact optimum for q>=6. Finite exhaustive small-alphabet optima q=3,4,5 are independently reproducible. Originality remains subject to unseen historical equivalences.
title: Linear-size identifying codes for undirected two-letter de Bruijn networks
